auditTitle: GhostWire VPN Zero-Knowledge & No-Logs Architecture Independent Audit
scope: Client Memory Allocation & Local Storage (Zero Disk Persistence)
Server-Side Operating System (Diskless Alpine Linux RAM Disk)
Tor-Over-VPN Circuit Isolation & Onion Routing Integrity

findings.diskPersistence: DISABLED - Servers execute exclusively in volatile RAM

formalStatement: Following rigorous source code review, black-box penetration testing, and live infrastructure packet captures under subpoena simulation, CureTrace confirms that GhostWire VPN retains zero identifying logs, zero IP addresses, and zero traffic metadata. It is technically impossible for the operators or any third party to reconstruct user activity.
